open_items: Hardware acceptance: document fit and electrical fault checks, then map water in at least five wells. Proposed targets: all measured water 36.5-37.5 C, spatial spread <=0.5 C, and recovery within 10 minutes after 30 seconds open. These are targets, not achieved performance.
Rev B: compare itemized machining and Type II finishing prices. Previous Rev A hardcoat estimates are not prices for the revised scope.
Integral housing remains a cost driver. A bolted roof/side/front alternative needs joint, alignment and thermal review before changing CAD.
Measure the purchased gasket before ordering its backing thickness; do not order a nine-frame cut shim kit.

29 machining/fabrication prospects, 4 direct anodizers and 4 component vendors contacted (37 distinct suppliers). Prickly Pear confirmed its preliminary $1,500–$2,000 indication covers anodizing ALONE; actual finishing quote and machining cost remain pending. The $4,000 machining allowance is not a quote.

The catalog subtotal is incomplete and excludes machining, unpriced parts, freight, tax, tariff, tools, calibration and revision work. Keep the $15,000 request provisional until quotes close those gaps.
Confirm five-channel measurement system with ≤0.2°C combined uncertainty near 37°C, small immersion probes and ≥1 sample/s/channel. Request calibration at 35/37/39°C.
Check what assembly tools, multimeter, water-dispensing equipment and balance are already available before budgeting replacements.
Shipping destination remains unset; RFQs request ex-works price and packed weight/dimensions. No lab lease or facility membership is required.
Review supplier replies on 2026-09-24. These are sent-mail records, not delivery receipts or automatic inbox monitoring.
DigiKey requires online myLists submission. The email request was acknowledged but did not produce a quote; Safari control is unavailable. The BOM remains ready for upload.

September 17 expansion: 20 additional individual RFQs confirmed in Sent Mail, each with the 2,480,834-byte manufacturing ZIP; no bounces found at the post-send check. 11 Thailand-based suppliers, Disk Precision corporate sales for its Thai factory, 3 Vietnam, 1 Malaysia, 4 China. Sent status does not establish delivery, acceptance or qualification.

US expansion September 17: 6 machining shops and 4 direct anodizers emailed individually, all 10 messages and manufacturing ZIPs verified in Sent Mail. No bounces found at the post-send check. Receipt, willingness to quote and final manufacturing location still require supplier confirmation.

Supplier feedback under review — Prickly Pear: standard imperial plate blanks plus laser cutting and finish machining may reduce stock and machining cost. Ask for affected part numbers, exact thicknesses and savings. Check mating dimensions, heater/sensor pockets, fastener engagement, flatness and final coated clearances before approval. Status: proposal, not accepted.

Supplier feedback under review — Prickly Pear: split U-housing into four doweled/bolted plates to reduce material removal and setups. Joint sketch and quantified savings requested. Check guide alignment, stiffness, gasket continuity, joint thermal conductance and access for assembly before approval. Status: proposal, not accepted.

Quote follow-up plan: review promised responses first (DwyerOmega 2–3 business days; Prickly Pear around September 23). For new suppliers without acknowledgment, check after 2 business days, then ask for a quote date or explicit decline. Review all remaining open requests September 24. This is a recorded plan, not automatic email scheduling.

design_review.title: Drawing clarity
design_review.decision: Rev B adds labeled hole schedules, overall dimensions, a heater/RTD masking diagram, and one representative drawing per duplicate part. CAD remains authoritative for unlisted geometry.

design_review.title: Prototype finish
design_review.decision: Use clear sealed Type II anodizing, 5-15 microns, with finished fit dimensions controlled. Retain masking for threads and defined adhesive lands. Hardcoat wear resistance is not an established V0 requirement; test warm drawer travel and inspect wear.

design_review.title: Coating allowance
design_review.decision: Anodize converts substrate as well as growing outward. The finisher must confirm the machining allowance; coating thickness must not be subtracted uniformly from every CAD surface.

design_review.title: Machining cost
design_review.decision: Base quote covers aluminum parts and guard sheets. Foam, backing, guide tape and electronics are owner-sourced. Plain cut-and-faced aluminum spacer tube is permitted. Larger cutters and bolted housing alternatives require explicit marked-up geometry review.
